structured_output.summary: The diff implements decodeURI in crates/kahvi-builtins/src/global/decode_uri.rs and follows the spec closely. decodeURI does ToString(encodedURI) first, then uses the preserve set ";/?:@&=+$,#" and calls Decode. Decode is a faithful transcription: the k+3 bounds checks, ParseHexOctet with not-integer throws, the n=0 preserve-set branch, the n==1 or n>4 check, the continuation loop with its '%' check and bounds check, UTF-8 validation via from_utf8 (which rejects overlong forms and surrogates), and UTF-16 encoding of the code point. Every abrupt case throws URIError through agent.throw_error. There are no test-shaped branches, no fallback values, and no panics on reachable paths, since indexing is guarded and parse_hex_octet uses get(). The only oddity is performance: per-call to_vec copies and an escape Vec allocated on each '%'. That may be why the two A2.5_T1 tests time out, but it is not a spec defect. The decode helper is pub(crate) in the same file, which the ticket permits for shared use by decodeURIComponent.
